description: Check a figure at its printed size: type too small, rules too fine, things off-canvas.
phrases: is this figure legible at column width
check a figure before submitting it
what is wrong with this figure
returns: one line per finding on stdout; counts on stderr; exit 1 if anything is wrong

examples.output:
warning  accessibility           -: this figure has no title; a reader who cannot see it has nothing to go on
warning  accessibility           -: this figure has no description; the geometry cannot supply one and nothing else will
unknown  contrast                art.ink.stroke-001: the canvas background is 'none', so there is nothing to measure contrast against
